verses.1: The god spoke to the fathers in many ways and in various forms through the prophets.
verses.2: On one of these last days, he spoke to us in his son. He appointed him as the heir to everything, and through him he created the seasons.
verses.3: He who was the source of his own glory and the characteristic feature of his status. He carried everything within himself through the power of his name. Through this, he was able to be purified from all sins. He stood at the right side of greatness, in a high position.
verses.4: As the messengers became more distinct from each other, their names also became more different.
verses.5: Wherefore have you ever spoken of messengers? “You are my son,” I said. “I have now given birth to you once more. I will be his father again, and he will be my son.”
verses.6: And when he again brought the prince back to his home, he said, “And all the angels of God worshipped him.”
verses.7: And to the angels, he said: “He gives them his spirits; and he gives the servants of His office fire and flames.”
verses.8: And to your son also: May the throne of God endure throughout the seasons of the year. And may the rod of judgment be a rod of kingship for you.
verses.9: You have loved justice and denied injustice. For this reason, God, your God, has given you oil of love among your descendants.
verses.10: And you, Lord, from the beginning, created the earth. And the works of your hands are seen in heaven.
verses.11: They will perish, while you will survive. And all of them will become old like old clothes.
verses.12: And just as you can choose to surround them with things that will protect them, so too will they change. But you yourself remain the same; your years will not change either.
verses.13: And to which of the messengers was it ever said that I would sit on my right side, until I could defeat your enemies under the weight of your feet?
verses.14: Are not all these spiritual forces sent forth for service, by those who will inherit salvation in the future?
